video.title: AI欧腐《权贵迷局/Noble's Gambit》
video.desc:
Outsider Elio enters House Voss to claim his place among the elite. Duke Kael offers protection at a price. When a stolen family seal makes Elio the prime suspect, he must navigate deadly alliances and forbidden desire. Elio wants power. Kael wants him. In House Voss, every promise has a price.
局外人 Elio 踏入 Voss家族，誓要在权贵之中争得一席之地。公爵 Kael 愿意庇护他，但庇护自有代价。一枚家族印章失窃，Elio 成了头号嫌疑人，他必须在致命的同盟与禁忌的欲望之间步步为营。Elio 想要权力，Kael 想要他。在 Voss家族，每一个承诺都有价码。
